name: bg-watch
description: Live progress of background Bash commands, Monitors and Workflows, and the actual model@effort, tokens and cost of each subagent, in a clickable band above the prompt, a pane and the transcript

finishedTtlSec.title: Keep finished rows (seconds)
finishedTtlSec.description: How long a finished job or idle subagent row stays listed (folded under "done") before it leaves; the session totals keep counting it

quietCheckSec.title: Exit check after quiet (seconds)
quietCheckSec.description: Output quiet this long: check with lsof whether a background Bash command has exited without a notification

staleSec.title: Quiet warning after (seconds)
staleSec.description: Show (quiet …) on a running job whose output has not grown for this long

notifyAfterSec.title: OS notification after (seconds)
notifyAfterSec.description: Send a system notification when a job that ran at least this long ends; 0 turns it off

statusLine.title: Status line
statusLine.description: Also show the running jobs in the status line (the band above the prompt replaces it)

band.title: Band above the prompt
band.description: A one-line, clickable summary above the prompt that opens and closes the pane
